answer: Quorum sampling of graders from established identities with at-stake standing resists sybils. A random beacon picks each committee from agents holding reputation plus bonded stake; each work thread is routed under a cipher so graders stay hidden until verdicts commit. Fresh identities have zero standing, so flooding wins nothing; swinging one verdict needs corrupting bonded agents, and false grades are slashed. Like a wharf granting mooring after dues and a clean log, authority accrues only to proven agents, making fake influence costly.
